name: Philter of Love

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Charmed for 1 hour by the next creature you see within 10 minutes of drinking it.
text: The next time you see a creature within 10 minutes after drinking this philter, you have the Charmed condition for 1 hour, regarding that creature as your true love while charmed. The rose-hued, effervescent liquid holds one easy-to-miss bubble shaped like a heart.
